items.headline: Rocket Thrusters on a Road Car Arrive as EV Makers Split Into Winners and Laggards
items.snippet: On October 12, the most active lithium carbonate contract on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange fell 11.8% to 104,740 yuan per ton, its lowest level in nearly ten months, and Albemarle shares fell 4.2% pre-market. Albemarle will release Q3 results on Wednesday, November 4.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; raising 2027 Energy Storage segment price forecast to $21k from $17k.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year; supply/demand appears poised to improve into 2027.
